name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
summary: Shadow Priest Sarvis stands inside the ruined chapel of Deathknell, serving as one of the primary guides for newly awakened Forsaken. He introduces fresh corpses to their grim reality, directing them to purge mindless undead and gather intelligence on local threats. Under Lady Sylvanas's banner, Sarvis works tirelessly to shape bewildered undead into disciplined servants of the Forsaken.

sections.title: Shepherd of the Newly Awakened
sections.body: Within the shadowy chapel of Deathknell, Shadow Priest Sarvis waits for those who have just clawed their way out of the grave. The awakening of a Forsaken soul is jarring and horrific, with many immediately losing their minds to mindless frenzy or despondency. Sarvis acts as an anchor, giving purpose to the newly risen. He assigns new recruits to put down the shambling, mindless corpses roaming the cemetery and directs them to secure Deathknell's borders against the encroaching Scourge.

sections.title: Securing Deathknell
sections.body: Beyond acclimating new recruits, Sarvis oversees crucial local defenses against lingering threats in Tirisfal Glades. He coordinates the containment of Scourge forces probing Deathknell's perimeter. By directing novices toward vital intelligence and martial trials, Sarvis ensures that the town remains a fortified bastion for the Forsaken.

faq.answer: Sarvis is a Forsaken shadow priest stationed in Deathknell. He guides freshly awakened undead, giving them their initial orders and helping secure the town against the Scourge.

faq.q: Where can I find Shadow Priest Sarvis?
faq.answer: He is located inside the ruined church at the center of Deathknell, the Forsaken starting area in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why is Sarvis having players kill mindless zombies?
faq.answer: Not every corpse raised from the grave retains their free will and sanity. Those who succumb to madness are deemed a hazard to the settlement and must be destroyed before they endanger the living dead.

angles.text: Sarvis is one of the very first voices you hear after waking from the grave, setting you on your path to serve the Dark Lady.
Sarvis exemplifies the Forsaken's embrace of shadow magic, serving as a dark mentor figure in a chapel stripped of Holy Light.
